title: Replace one method body in a large file
prompt: In the Billing module, the static class InvoiceText (backend/Bench.Modules.Billing/Shared/Formatting/InvoiceText.cs) has many formatting methods. Replace the body of PaymentReminder(string customer, decimal amount) so that it returns the text Dear {customer trimmed}, please pay {amount rounded to 2 places, formatted with F2 and the invariant culture} within 14 days. For example, PaymentReminder("  acme  ", 1234.567m) returns "Dear acme, please pay 1234.57 within 14 days.". Keep its signature, and change no other method.
